items.title: Ather Energy Q4 Results: Loss narrows to Rs 100 crore; revenue jumps 74% YoY
items.description: Ather Energy Q4 Results: Ather Energy reported a net loss of Rs 100 crore for Q4 FY26, a 57% decrease year-on-year, alongside a 74% revenue jump to Rs 1,175 crore. The company's EBITDA loss narrowed significantly, driven by strong volume growth and improved unit economics, with deliveries reaching 83,418 units.

items.title: Ambuja Cements Q4 Results: Cons profit surges 78% YoY to Rs 1,830 crore; revenue rises 10%
items.description: Ambuja Cements Q4 results: The company's revenue from operations in Q4FY26 stood at Rs 10,892 crore, up 10% from Rs 9,894 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year.

items.title: Godrej Properties posts quarterly profit rise on housing demand
items.description: Indian real estate developer Godrej Properties reported ​a 70% rise in ​fourth-quarter profit on Monday as demand ​for residential apartments stayed high.
